I replied to Dana in their DM: their cutoff for the Brackenwater Freight Co. (Juniper) paperwork is 26 Sep.

That date comes from my saved notes on what Dana told me earlier in this DM. The DM itself only shows today's question, so I couldn't check it against the original message. Since 26 Sep is before today (17 Oct), I told Dana the date has already passed and offered to help if it changed or they need to follow up.

I didn't mention another member's separate Brackenwater cutoff from my notes, because they told me that privately.
